meta.about: Measured from the render (ID pass pixel statistics) of PAE-02 SCION 47. x_screen/y_screen: dog body centroid (px). facing: +1 muzzle left of skull (toward the door), -1 away, from the ID pass. state: switches at the measured onsets below. Camera is fixed, so x_screen is the world position up to scale.

onsets.detector: dog drawing changes after the hold (body, head or top edge moves >= 2 px)
head rises >= 4 px above its lowest point while backing
dog drawing changes after the hold (body, head or top edge moves >= 2 px)
head moves >= 3 px after the refusal hold (head only: breath moves the chest)
body centroid moves toward the door >= 2 px (sniffing moves only the head)

onsets.choice: looks in -> settles, chin down, stays

sound_to_action.cause: soft1 "It's all right." cue vowel of 'it'
the call stops sounding (last phone of "Come on!")
the dog's own third sniff, after 3.2 s of silence
it has arrived at the sill and stopped (the score x stops); its footsteps stop

lipsync.note: measured on the ID pass: pixels of the open-mouth interior drawn by the viseme; silence = more than 2 frames from any phone
